questions.question: Q1 What does PCIe stand for?

explanations.a: Correct. PCIe is a high-speed serial expansion bus standard.

questions.question: Q2 What is the approximate bandwidth of PCIe Gen4 x16?

explanations.a: Incorrect. This is PCIe Gen3 x16.
explanations.b: Incorrect. This is half the Gen4 bandwidth.
explanations.c: Correct. PCIe Gen4 x16 provides approximately 64 GB/s.
explanations.d: Incorrect. This is PCIe Gen5 x16.

questions.question: Q4 What happens when data transfer time exceeds compute time?

answers.b: The workload becomes I/O-bound and GPU sits idle

explanations.a: Incorrect. Compute-bound means compute time dominates.
explanations.b: Correct. When Tt > Tc, the GPU spends more time waiting than computing.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Longer transfer times directly reduce utilization.

questions.question: Q5 Which interconnect technology is designed specifically for GPU-to-GPU communication?

explanations.a: Incorrect. USB is for peripheral devices.
explanations.b: Incorrect. SATA is for storage devices.
explanations.c: Correct. NVLink is NVIDIA's proprietary high-bandwidth GPU interconnect.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Ethernet is for network communication.

questions.question: Q6 What unit is data transfer latency typically measured in?

explanations.c: Correct. Transfer latency is a time measurement.

questions.question: Q7 What is the main advantage of higher interconnect bandwidth?

answers.b: Faster data transfer and higher GPU utilization

explanations.a: Incorrect. Higher bandwidth may actually increase power.
explanations.b: Correct. More bandwidth means data arrives faster, reducing GPU idle time.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Bandwidth is unrelated to storage.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Display quality is unrelated to data interconnects.

questions.question: Q8 What is a tensor in the context of AI computing?

answers.b: A multi-dimensional array of numerical data

explanations.b: Correct. Tensors are the fundamental data structure used in deep learning computations.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Tensor cores exist but tensors themselves are data.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Tensors are unrelated to cooling.

questions.question: Q9 What is bandwidth measured in for data interconnects?

explanations.c: Correct. Bandwidth is the data transfer rate measured in GB/s.

questions.question: Q10 Why is GPU idle time a problem in data centers?

answers.b: It wastes expensive computing resources that could be performing useful work

explanations.a: Incorrect. While idle GPUs generate less heat, the wasted compute is the primary concern.
explanations.b: Correct. GPU idle time means expensive silicon is not performing useful computation.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Idle time does not affect storage.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Idle GPUs represent significant financial waste.
